## Website Uptime Monitor + Status Page
- Checks every site in **Check Sites** every 5 minutes (edit the SITES list).
- Keeps 24h of history per site (status code, response time, up/slow/down).
- Public status page: `/webhook/status`
- No API keys or credentials required. Add a Telegram/Slack/email node after **Record Results** to alert on `stateChanges`.
